title: WSPolypNet: Weakly Supervised Polyp Localization in Colonoscopy Videos
abstract: arXiv:2609.08182v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Because dense frame-level annotation of colonoscopy videos is costly, we propose WSPolypNet, a weakly supervised framework for polyp localization using only video-level labels. WSPolypNet employs a 3D convolutional neural network trained with video-level supervision to generate class activation maps (CAMs), which identify candidate polyp regions without requiring frame-level spatial annotations. The CAM-derived localization cues are further enhanced using a multi-view strategy and provided to MedSAM2 as point prompts. MedSAM2 then propagates segmentation masks across the video, refining the coarse localization cues according to polyp boundaries. WSPolypNet achieved CorLoc scores of 47.80%, 43.68%, and 35.01% at IoU thresholds of 0.3, 0.5, and 0.7, respectively, compared with 36.87%, 33.72%, and 27.94% in the single-view setting. translated_abstract: 由于对结肠镜视频进行密集的帧级标注成本高昂，我们提出了WSPolypNet，这是一个仅使用视频级标签进行息肉定位的弱监督框架。WSPolypNet采用3D卷积神经网络，在视频级监督下训练生成类激活图（CAM），从而在无需帧级空间标注的情况下识别候选息肉区域。通过多视角策略进一步增强CAM获得的定位线索，并将其作为点提示提供给MedSAM2。MedSAM2随后在整个视频中传播分割掩码，根据息肉边界对粗糙的定位线索进行细化。WSPolypNet在IoU阈值为0.3、0.5和0.7时分别取得了47.80%、43.68%和35.01%的CorLoc分数，而单视角设置下仅为36.87%、33.72%和27.94%。对于小息肉，多视角策略将CorLoc@0.5从16.01%提升至30.97%。该框架还取得了（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出WSPolypNet弱监督框架，仅利用视频级标签，结合3D卷积网络生成的类激活图与多视角增强策略，并通过MedSAM2掩码传播，实现了结肠镜视频中无需帧级标注的息肉精确定位，尤其显著提升了小息肉的定位性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes WSPolypNet, a weakly supervised framework that localizes polyps in colonoscopy videos using only video-level labels by combining CAMs from a 3D CNN with a multi-view strategy and MedSAM2 mask propagation, substantially improving localization accuracy especially for small polyps.
